overview_description.description:
String is the All-in-One, AI-Native Operating System that lets schools put all their software apps in one platform and gives them the power of AI.
With only one account per user, schools get access to a web-based digital learning environment, where they access their learning software products. All data, accounts, software licenses, and subscriptions are managed and synchronized under one dashboard and one shared memory for all apps.
